source_text.body:
Run a task system with daily to-dos and reminders
An author built a Cowork task system driven by CLAUDE.md that moves tasks between folders, generates a prioritised daily to-do list, and sends reminders and check-ins, saving about an hour a week.
Done with
CW
Claude Cowork
What they did
Alena Gorb made a tasks folder in Claude Cowork with planned, in-progress, completed, to-do-list and research subfolders. A CLAUDE.md file, which Claude wrote for her, sets the rules. She describes work conversationally and Claude files and moves tasks. Scheduled tasks build a prioritised list at 9:30 AM and run a 5 PM check-in.
How it went
She estimates it saves about an hour a week and cuts morning planning time. It lapses if she stops reporting tasks, and cross-category dependencies are sometimes missed.
Worth knowing
Setup took her 1-2 hours. She skipped the optional email connector over concern about giving Claude access to her work Microsoft account.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Cowork
Copy prompt
Set up a simple task system in my folder [path to a folder for tasks]. Create subfolders for [e.g. Inbox, Today, Waiting, Done], write a CLAUDE.md that explains the rules for moving tasks between them, and each morning generate a prioritised to-do list from what's in the folders. Finished when the folders and CLAUDE.md exist and you've shown me a first daily to-do list; before moving or deleting any existing files, show me the plan and wait for my approval.
Original source: https://savvysloth.substack.com/p/how-i-built-an-ai-powered-task-management
